title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the fansub CRC checksum sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Fansub CRC Sheet
options.thesis: Library as a verification sheet: shows grouped by title, episodes as checked rows, Play as the next verify.
options.viewport: Left rail of named zones; right pane is a title column then episode rows with Play on the selected show.
options.risk: Can feel like a log dump if grouping and Play do not lead.

raised.raise: Rows are live entities: playback and download restyle the line without breaking the grid.
Numeric metadata stays tabular and dense; one focused title, surrounding rows stay faint.
Each title keeps a fixed-scale cover column so shows remain comparable at a glance.
Hairline registration marks the active title block; primary Play is a filled rect, not a pill.
Every zone is labeled with its literal name; wayfinding is reading, not icon decoding.
One type family behaves as matter: titles monumental, rows condensed, never mixed display faces.

options.label: MPV OSC Overlay
options.thesis: The library as an OSC: covers fill the field, Play sits on the selected title like a timeline hit.
options.viewport: Dark field of title posters; selected show expands a bottom OSC strip with episodes and Play.
options.risk: Also the direction most anime-desktop runs land on.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Titles as timed rows; episode state flips in place like a destination change.
options.viewport: Ruled rows of titles ranked by recency; Play is the selected row’s action cell.
options.case: Audience identification is strong; grouping-by-show is less clear than a sheet.
options.risk: Cascade motion can fight scanability on a typical library.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.case: Loses identification and clarity: viewers do not browse anime as a barcode field.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.case: Loses both axes: cream-plate nature study is not this audience’s home.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.case: Loses identification: print-annual furniture is not how this audience watches.

options.label: Industrial Quote Tags
options.case: Loses both: quoted fashion grammar obscures episode work.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark streaming-app shell: poster grid, left nav, orange Play.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar plus poster grid of titles, Play on the selected show.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every anime client by design.
